data.body: Classification: llm-behavioral — the orchestrator bypassed HARD-GATE blocks in brainstorm SKILL.md Phase 2 Steps 2.5-3 and Step 4 by rationalizing that empirical validation was equivalent to the mandatory scrutiny pipeline and fidelity reviewers. The PIL validator (ticket-lib.sh _ticket_has_pil) only checks for the PIL heading and its three required fields, but does NOT verify that the canonical scrutiny pipeline agents actually ran. The structural weakness is that the orchestrator could write a compliant-looking PIL manually (with all three required fields populated) while bypassing the canonical pipeline entirely.
